description: Reads or sets the Board's shared view state (filter, pins, expanded variant clusters), in-memory, shared by viewers. filter: case-insensitive substring of screen name or tag, null/blank clears. pins/expanded: {op: add|remove|set, screens} or {op: clear}; expanded: a main screen or any variant. Omitted fields stay; none = pure read. Returns the state and shown_count; fields ["shown_screens"] lists them.
name: set_board_state
